Darkness rises over Middle-earth. Season 3 follows Sauron's journey to forge the One Ring — the master ring to rule them all — as Galadriel and Celeborn reunite, Gandalf warns of the death to come, and war engulfs the free peoples. Simon Pegg joins the cast as the voice of the Balrog, the fire demon that helps Sauron at the forge.
